title: Time integration method selector
overview: Selects the time-integration method stored in Ctrl::time_integral. The global solver dispatch maps MULTI_STAGE to RungeKutta, SIMPLE to Simple, and every other value to Lusgs. The context-aware Relaxation overload applies the same dispatch.
principle: This is a discrete algorithm-selection parameter, not a continuous physical coefficient. Its meaning is defined by the dispatch branches that consume the stored selector. Unsupported or unrecognized values currently follow the Lusgs fallback branch; this declaration does not redefine that compatibility behavior as input validation.
architecture: The value is read by Ctrl::Init, NsCtrl::Init, INsCtrl::Init, and TurbCtrl::Init. The shared TimeIntegral implementation owns the method dispatch. Euler resident-backend eligibility is a separate capability decision and must not be conflated with selecting the RungeKutta method.

proves: The four listed control initializers read the selector.
TimeIntegral::Init and the context-aware Relaxation overload dispatch MULTI_STAGE, SIMPLE, and fallback values as described.
does_not_prove: The selected method's temporal order or stability region.
That every solver configuration can use the resident Euler RungeKutta backend.
Numerical accuracy or physical validity of a particular case.

verification.scope: Source-backed dispatch declaration; source links are listed under Implementation. No test execution is implied.
Context-aware overload applies the same method dispatch; no test execution is implied.
